text:
elaine: Quick follow-up: overnight dependency outage where vendor auth started returning 429s in us-west and eu-central, causing model-registry read retries and a short 5xx spike for hosted inference. Opening action thread.

sam: saw the alert. any Dedicated tenant impact?

elaine: Four Dedicated tenants had latency blips; overall ~2.8% 5xx for ~40m. No data loss. Chain: vendor 429s on token introspect -> registry client retries -> connection pool saturation -> downstream 500s.

priya: vendor admits a rollout misconfiguration that changed introspect rate keys. They're producing an RCA.

jon: this matches previous "token-throttle" incidents. recommend we treat as recurring class and track trend.

marta: vendor ticket opened (#VND-3012). CS logged two support tickets; prepping comms.

elaine: Proposed actions and owners:
- Hotfix (P0): increase local token cache TTL (30s -> 5m) and add jittered exponential backoff on introspect retries. Owner: priya. Target: EOD+1.
- Near-term (P1): add a token circuit-breaker (fast-fail) and emit circuit metrics. Owner: sam. Target: 2w.
- Fallback (P1): prototype an auth fallback proxy (ephemeral signing via KMS) behind a feature flag; security review required. Owner: sam + devsec. Target: 3w.
- Vendor (P0): request quota correction, dedicated auth key, and a formal postmortem. Owner: marta. Target: 72h.
- Runbook (P1): detection rule for auth 429 bursts + synthetic canary that simulates throttling. Owner: jon. Target: 5d.
- Governance (LOW): add recurrence tag to resilience board and an "action aging" rule to escalate P0s older than 72h. Owner: elaine. Target: next board meeting.

priya: taking hotfix; will open PR to bump cache TTL and add metrics (cache-hit ratio, retry-saturation). ETA: tomorrow EOD.

sam: will design circuit-breaker and evaluate fallback proxy options (local minting vs vendor backup). will coordinate with devsec. ETA: 2w for design.

jjon: typo in my earlier message; will add detection rules and staging canary. ETA: 5 days.

ops-bot: Actions logged INC-2422: https://tracker.internal/INC-2422 (items: TOKEN-902, CB-903, PROXY-904, VND-3012, RUN-905).

marta: preparing customer comms template; will escalate vendor if no RCA in 48h.

elaine: Recap of owners/due dates: priya (TOKEN-902) due 3123532800; sam (CB-903 & PROXY-904) due 3124339200 & 3124944000; jon (RUN-905) due 3123494400; marta (VND-3012) due 3123501600. Weekly resilience sync scheduled for next 4 weeks.

priya: ack, starting work.

sam: ack.

jon: ack, will draft runbook edits.

marta: ack, monitoring vendor response.

elaine: Closing thread for now; will update INC-2422 with progress and reopen if vendor response or blockers surface. Thanks all :thumbsup:
